title: Valuing a Kiosk Trip for a Late-Booked Client Discount
content:
Where a client discount is worked out for a micro market kiosk trip in the Unattended Micro Market Program after the event, how busy the kiosk has been over the quarter and whether the agreement carries an approved kiosk outage request can change which drawdown on the agreement the trip is valued from.

## The clause

1. Where the kiosk posted at or above 8 drawdowns over the three months to the day the discount is worked out and the agreement carries an approved kiosk outage request over the same three months, the trip is valued at the mean drawdown taken over the reading window.
2. Where the kiosk posted below 8 drawdowns over those three months and the agreement carries an approved kiosk outage request over the same three months, the trip is valued at the largest drawdown ever posted against the agreement.
3. Where neither of those holds, no such change to the valuation of the trip is made.

The busy-kiosk trip count is 8 drawdowns. A quarter of exactly 8 drawdowns is at or above that count; a quarter of 7 is below it.

## Condition and judgement

| Drawdowns posted over the three months | Approved kiosk outage request over the same three months | Judgement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 8 or more | at least one | the trip is valued at the mean drawdown taken over the reading window |
| 7 or fewer | at least one | the trip is valued at the largest drawdown ever posted against the agreement |
| 8 or more | none | no such change to the valuation is made |
| 7 or fewer | none | no such change to the valuation is made |

## Hypothetical readings

An agreement whose kiosk posted 11 drawdowns in the three months to the working day, with one approved kiosk outage request in that same window, is valued at the mean drawdown taken over the reading window. Had the same agreement posted 6 drawdowns with that outage request standing, the trip would be valued at the largest drawdown ever posted against it. With no approved kiosk outage request standing in those three months, neither line is reached, whether the quarter carried 11 drawdowns or 6.
